This species is only known from the type locality, Yingshan Cave (Figs 1 E, 27 A), which is located about 2 km northwest of Qixin Village (Zhenxiong County) and near the top of a mountain. This limestone cave has one small and square entrance (about 1 m high and 1 m wide), but a huge and downward sloping interior space. The ground is covered with silt. About 300 m of the cave have beenexplored but the total length of the cave is unknown. All of the specimens were collected under stones within 20 to 200 m from the cave entrance. The cool, high-humidity and dark interior environment (temperature around 14 ° C on average, humidity over 90 %) is suitable for the survival of the species.
